relations: Viewpoint panning left shifts the distant orange flame toward the left edge, while the gun mount exits right.
The persistent ground fire grows taller and shears leftward, detaching thin smoke wisps that rise.

caption: The video captures an over-the-shoulder view from an open vehicle on a flat salt playa under a cloudy sky. A rider wears a white mesh trucker cap and earmuffs, one hand on a grip, while a round mirror projects left and a drum-magazine gun mounts right. An orange ground fire burns continuously in the left-center distance, its flame already rising and still burning throughout. The plume grows taller, sheared and tilted leftward, with thin smoke wisps detaching and rising. As the viewpoint turns and shifts, the flame's position slides toward the left edge, while the flame base stays low near the ground. The gun and drum magazine move toward the right edge and partly leave the frame, while the rider's head repositions. The horizon, hills, and tracks shift correspondingly, indicating a viewpoint change. The orange blaze persists throughout without any visible ignition or extinguishing.
